### Headline summary
- Anthropic is making significant moves in governance and safety, committing shares to a public benefit fund and granting outside watchdogs employee-like access. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-18/anthropic-plans-to-shift-some-shares-into-new-public-good-fund), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/anthropic-commits-5-of-its-shares-to-new-public-benefit-fund/), [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/10/anthropic-gives-outside-ai-watchdog-employee-like-access/))
- Major industry shifts include Disney hiring the majority of Character.AI's workforce and Microsoft cancelling its Essex AI data center deal. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261017/p21#a261017p21), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/18/disney-agrees-to-hire-the-majority-of-character-ais-workforce/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261018/p4#a261018p4), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/oct/18/microsoft-drops-huge-ai-datacentre-project-in-essex-over-power-supply-concerns))
- Anthropic has issued a warning regarding the potential for AI models to self-replicate across home devices. ([Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/13/anthropic-ai-models-self-replication-smart-devices.html), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/oct/18/anthropic-ai-worm-worries))

### Anthropic commits shares to new public benefit fund
Anthropic announced plans to allocate 5% of its shares to a new fund or LLC dedicated to public-interest initiatives and public good. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-18/anthropic-plans-to-shift-some-shares-into-new-public-good-fund), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/anthropic-commits-5-of-its-shares-to-new-public-benefit-fund/), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/anthropic-public-benefit-fund-2026-10))

### Disney hires majority of Character.AI workforce
Following Character.AI's bankruptcy filing, Disney agreed to hire over 60 staff members, paying approximately $180 million over three years plus retention awards. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261017/p21#a261017p21), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/18/disney-agrees-to-hire-the-majority-of-character-ais-workforce/))

### Microsoft cancels Essex AI data center deal
Microsoft has dropped its planned AI data center project in Essex, UK, citing power supply concerns and cancelling its deal with Nscale to rent Nvidia chips. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261018/p4#a261018p4), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/oct/18/microsoft-drops-huge-ai-datacentre-project-in-essex-over-power-supply-concerns))

### Anthropic warns of self-replicating AI worms
Anthropic issued a warning that AI models could potentially self-replicate across home devices, a threat the company describes as requiring more capability on less powerful hardware. ([Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/13/anthropic-ai-models-self-replication-smart-devices.html), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/oct/18/anthropic-ai-worm-worries))

### Anthropic gives outside AI watchdog “employee-like” access
Anthropic has granted external evaluators “employee-like access” to assess the risks of its models, following through on a commitment to increase safeguards over concerns the technology could run catastrophically out of control. METR, a nonprofit that has worked with leading labs including OpenAI,… ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/10/anthropic-gives-outside-ai-watchdog-employee-like-access/))

### Sources: Nvidia asked Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron to make base dies for its custom NVHBM memory on TSMC's 3nm process…
Kyu-Seok Shim / Reuters : Sources: Nvidia asked Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron to make base dies for its custom NVHBM memory on TSMC's 3nm process; Samsung agreed, its first use of TSMC — Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) will use TSMC's (2330.TW) 3-nanometre process to produce base dies for Nvidia's… ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261018/p9#a261018p9))

### Anthropic consults law firms on AI negotiation norms
Anthropic is consulting with law firms to develop fair negotiation norms and tactics for AI agents that will negotiate deals on behalf of humans. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261018/p2#a261018p2), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/anthropic-consults-law-firms-to-set-fair-negotiation-norms-before-ai-agents-start-cutting-deals/))

### Leaked Anthropic Draft AI Regulatory Bill Is Unacceptable and Troubling
([Hacker News (AI tag)](https://thezvi.substack.com/p/leaked-anthropic-draft-ai-regulatory))
